credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Georgia O'Keeffe standing on a rock next to the water with her hands on hip. She is wearing a light colored jacket, shirt, PF Flyer sneakers with her black wide brimmed hat hanging on her back.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe at Water's Edge
